Use case: stylized-concept. Professional Japanese 2D visual-novel PRODUCTION DETAIL SHEET on a warm very pale grey opaque background. Match Image 1 exactly for color, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material, no painterly texture. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no character full body and no scenery. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
AUTHORITATIVE DETAILS TO DRAW: flower close-up on head, upper-arm sleeve attachment, dress front and back waist construction, two ribbon attachment points, complete circular silver astrolabe front/side and notebook.
EXACT OBJECT RULES: One floating silver astrolabe: a COMPLETE circular flat ring 24 cm across, ONE fixed simple four-point silver star at center and ONE blue round center stone. No crescent, no broken ring, no orbiting crystals. One thin plain ivory notebook with lavender spine used only in writing scenes.
HARD LOCKS: 银紫短发; 本人左鬓白花1朵; 背腰冰蓝飘带2条; 完整银圆环星盘; 无长发与腿链.
Every object must be shown once unless front/back or open/closed views are explicitly requested. Keep counts exact. No additional jewelry, charms, stars, chains, flowers, weapons, readable writing or decorative filler.
